decision: enforce hosted/local Node QA parity with an executable guard
problem: The local QA shard list included agents/qubes-idempotency-independence.test.mjs while .github/workflows/node-qa.yml omitted it, so a future hosted green run could be weaker than local qualification evidence.

reviews.preferred: shared parity guard plus explicit hosted coverage
reviews.reason: A green hosted run must cover every semantic test file represented by the local evidence runner.

reviews.preferred: fail closed when workflow/local shard definitions drift
reviews.reason: Silent coverage drift is more dangerous than an explicit QA failure, especially for Qubes readiness gates.
It adds no runtime worker traffic, no external dependency, negligible CPU/IO, and does not modify production orchestration semantics.

alternatives.rejectedBecause: not repeatable and already allowed drift
adds build tooling and workflow-generation complexity for little benefit
hosted sharding intentionally does not invoke the monolithic npm test command

lessons: Fallback QA and hosted QA can diverge unless parity is executable.
A CI green result is only meaningful if coverage is itself guarded.
Keep this fix qualification-only; do not change MissionQueue or qrexec production semantics while hosted runners are failing before first step.
